model.name: SAM3 reduced no-text runtime
model.deployment_note: Text encoder is executed offline on CPU; cached projected text features are supplied to the GPU segmentation runtime.

flops.counting_scope: One complete forward pass of the reduced SAM3 GPU runtime at batch 1 and 336x336 input, including vision encoder, DETR components, scoring, and mask decoder; offline text encoder is excluded.
flops.convention: PyTorch FlopCounterMode convention. Only operations with registered FLOP formulas are counted; the result is an operator-counted estimate, not an exact count of every scalar operation.

memory.note: Jetson uses unified memory. Free shared memory and process RSS are reported; PyTorch allocator peak is invalid when PYTORCH_NO_CUDA_MEMORY_CACHING=1.
